title: map-preview's juice_scene hand-copy has already drifted: hardcoded QoS weights {9,1,0}/{1,1,8} match no preset — juice.dem lowers to {4,2,1}/{1,2,4}
evidence: harness/map_preview.odin:26 claims 'spawn/draw verbs, lifted verbatim so the preview == the shipped golden's / scene minus the map)' yet map_preview.odin:70-72 hardcodes: '// the QoS emphases (Express-heavy on pipe 7, Best-effort-heavy on pipe 2)' / 'pp.topology_apply_edit(&state.topology, pp.Command{kind = pp.Cmd_Set_Weights{pipe = 7, weights = {9, 1, 0}}}, cat)' / 'pp.topology_apply_edit(&state.topology, pp.Command{kind = pp.Cmd_Set_Weights{pipe = 2, weights = {1, 1, 8}}}, cat)'. The source of truth differs: demos/juice.dem:47-48 'at 100ms emphasis 7 express_heavy' / 'at 100ms emphasis 2 best_effort_heavy'; harness/run.odin:83-84 lowers '// 5.8 payload: the command carries the weight set — a preset is one.' / 'w := cat.balance.lane_presets[preset_idx].weights'; data/balance.json:43-51 '"id": "express_heavy", ... "weights": [4, 2, 1]' / '"id": "best_effort_heavy", ... "weights": [1, 2, 4]'. A repo-wide grep finds {9,1,0}/{1,1,8} nowhere else.
detail: The preview is NOT the golden's scene: pipes 7 and 2 carry different lane allocations, so lane stripes render differently. The hand-copied fixture rots silently with no mechanical tie to juice.dem.
recommended_fix: Resolve the presets like run.odin does (pp.preset_index → cat.balance.lane_presets[idx].weights), or parse demos/juice.dem with a seed override — one source of truth for the fixture.

title: palcheck section labels are physically out of order after the 7.4 insertions (1d precedes 1c; 'section 3' precedes section 2)
evidence: File order of the section headers read from harness/palcheck.odin: line 155 '// 1d. the 7.4 procedural-map palette (canon D9 — the map renders on EVERY' comes BEFORE line 170 '// 1c. the banner-rect agreement: the drawn critical-red hairline must sit'; line 211 '// --- 3. the 7.4 map-identity pin (canon D9 determinism) -------------------' comes BEFORE line 228 '// --- 2. the zoomed lane read (the app-layer lane_detail reveal) ---------'. The pin constant's comment (line 38) cross-references 'change updates this constant in the same PR (palcheck section 3).'
detail: Numbered sections no longer match file order; future readers grepping 'section 3' or editing palcheck encounter misordered anchors — small but real reader debt.
recommended_fix: Renumber sections sequentially in file order (1a-1e, then 2, 3) in the next palcheck-touching PR, keeping the MAP_IDENTITY_PIN cross-reference in sync.
